evidence.observedFact: The business requires parties or groups of three or more to reserve two weeks in advance, requests a 50% deposit plus a credit-card hold, and states that group cancellations must be rescheduled to avoid losing the deposit.
The business actively sells spa parties for birthdays, bachelor/bachelorette parties, anniversaries, bridal parties, office parties, employee incentives and other group occasions for 3 to 15 guests.
The business says appointment and inquiry emails are checked only once or twice daily and directs customers to call for a quick response on availability.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate a group-event capture workflow that enrolls spa-party guests into measurable post-event rewards and return-visit sequences.
Add automated pre-visit reminders, confirmation nudges and reschedule recovery around high-value group reservations.
Demonstrate immediate automated acknowledgement and follow-up for appointment and availability inquiries while preserving phone-based booking.

recommendedEntryOffer: Spa Party Retention + Booking Recovery Revenue Engine
notes: Observed facts show group-event volume opportunities and explicit booking/follow-up constraints. Hypothesis: Places Rewards can help convert event guests into trackable repeat visitors and reduce leakage around inquiry follow-up. No monetary loss is claimed from public evidence.
